This file marks that `staging` carries help pages about screens only the new Tallyfy client has.

The hold `process-views-next-gen` in `.github/promotion-holds.txt` names this file, so any
promotion whose tree contains it fails. A full `staging` to `main` promotion carries it and is
stopped. A subset promotion that leaves this file and the five pages below alone still ships.

Why: by owner decision on 2026-10-30, the pages describing the new client's process views stay
on docs staging until the new client has users, because only the legacy client is used in
production (tallyfy/client#24707, tallyfy/documentation#442).

The five pages, all under `src/content/docs/pro/`:

- tracking-and-tasks/can-i-build-a-flowchart-in-tallyfy.mdx
- tracking-and-tasks/tasks-view/how-can-i-customize-task-views-in-tallyfy.mdx
- tracking-and-tasks/processes/index.mdx
- documenting/templates/edit-templates/edit-steps.mdx
- documenting/templates/edit-templates/step-timings.mdx

A subset promotion that copies one of these whole files from `staging` carries the new client
sections with it. Take only the lines you mean to ship.

To lift it, at client-v2 general availability (tallyfy/work-queue#4459): delete the hold's line
in `.github/promotion-holds.txt`, delete this file, and promote.
